title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving WASH response package to vulnerable communities and IDPs affected by El Nino in Baidoa district of Somalia

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe heavy rains and floods linked to the El Nino weather phenomena have killed dozens of people and caused widespread displacement, destruction of infrastructures, particularly in Somalia, where the rains have wrecked bridges and submerged residential areas. According to SoDMA and humanitarian partners more than 1.7 million people are in need as torrential rains destroyed their homes, existing WASH infrastructures and livelihoods in Somalia. The number of people displaced by heavy rains and floods in Somalia has nearly doubled in one week from 334,800 to 649,000 (OCHA Somalia Flood sitrep/17th Nov. 2023. Over half a million more people have been affected, bringing the total to 1.7 million, up from 1.17 million a week ago. This figure exceeds planning and preparedness figures. The torrential rains and floods have exacerbated the hunger crisis in Somalia. ltbrgtAccording to Somalia WASH Cluster update (Nov 2023), since the onset of 2023 Deyr Season, heavy rains fell in south-West State of Somalia have resulted in historic flash floods across Baidoa district with over 400,000 affected. In addition, floods have resulted widespread damage to the already limited WASH facilities (latrines and water sources) in Southwest State. ltbrgtIn response to this unforeseen Elnino flooding, particularly in Baidoa district, WARDO, through SHF fund, plans to implement life-saving WASH intervention targeting a total of 25,000 people affected by the flood in Baidoa. ltbrgt Deliver emergency voucher water supply to 15,000 people for a short duration of 2 monthsltbrgt Rehabilitation of 4 shallow well serving 2,000 flood affected communities in Baidoaltbrgt Construction of new a total of 96 new latrines serving 2,880 flood affected people living IDP camps.ltbrgt Hygiene promotion and kits distribution targeting 25,000 people from IDPs and poor host communities in Baidoaltbrgt Provision of solid waste management service including distribution of 85 sanitation tool kits to undertake cleanup campaigns and draining stagnated flood water in and around houses with specially focus on IDP settlements.ltbrgt Regular water quality monitoring and treatment for a total of 20 water sources in Baidoa town.ltbrgtWARDO will ensure community participation and inclusion in all project implementation process and will promote women participation in project activities including sustainable management of constructed and rehabilitated WASH facilities.ltbrgtlt/pgt
